title: IC 814 in one minute (English style test)

NARRATOR.desc: Dagar English narrator (Chatterbox Turbo, fixed ref)

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: December 24, 1999. An Indian Airlines flight leaves Kathmandu for Delhi.
lines.say: December twenty-fourth, nineteen ninety-nine. An Indian Airlines flight leaves Kathmandu for Delhi.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Around 190 people are on board. And five of them carried weapons, not tickets.
lines.say: Around one hundred and ninety people are on board. And five of them carried weapons, not tickets.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Forty minutes in, a masked man stands up with a grenade. The plane is hijacked.
lines.say: Forty minutes in, a masked man stands up with a grenade. [gasp] The plane is hijacked.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: It lands in Amritsar for fuel. India has forty-five minutes to stop it. It doesn't.
lines.say: It lands in Amritsar for fuel. India has forty-five minutes to stop it. [sigh] It doesn't.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The plane flies on. Lahore. Dubai. And finally Kandahar, in Taliban-ruled Afghanistan.
lines.say: The plane flies on. Lahore. Dubai. And finally Kandahar, in Taliban-ruled Afghanistan.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: The hijackers demand 36 jailed militants. After seven days, India agrees to three.
lines.say: The hijackers demand thirty-six jailed militants. After seven days, India agrees to three.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Foreign Minister Jaswant Singh flies them to Kandahar himself. The hostages come home on New Year's Eve.
lines.say: Foreign Minister Jaswant Singh flies them to Kandahar himself. The hostages come home on New Year's Eve.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: But one of the three, Masood Azhar, starts a new group within weeks. Jaish-e-Mohammed.
lines.say: But one of the three, Masood Azhar, starts a new group within weeks. Jaish-e-Mohammed.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: India blames it for the 2001 Parliament attack, and for Pulwama in 2019.
lines.say: India blames it for the two thousand one Parliament attack, and for Pulwama in twenty nineteen.

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: So here's the question. Did India save lives that week, or pay for it for 26 years?
lines.say: So here's the question. Did India save lives that week, or pay for it for twenty-six years?

lines.speaker: NARRATOR
lines.text: Tell me in the comments. And follow for the next file.
lines.say: Tell me in the comments. And follow for the next file.
